issues.legal_issue: Whether a religious service grant was made to a temple or personally to its officiating priests subject to their rendering service.
material_facts: The register described the grant as hereditary, identified the deity as grantee and the priests as enjoyers, and recorded an individual holder and the heirs of the original priests.

An official recommended that the grant be treated as made to persons rendering service to the temple, and the confirmation of the grant made it conditional on the temple service being properly performed.
The title deed confirmed the grant to an individual priest and his successors, subject to fulfillment of the grant’s conditions.
issues.conclusion: The grant was made to the priests, not to the temple, and the property was burdened with the obligation to render service to the temple.
issues.legal_principle: The description Devadayam indicates the religious character of an endowment but does not, by itself, establish that the temple owns the property; it can also describe a service inam attached to a temple (Venkayya v. Sriramamurthy). A description of a grant as hereditary normally supports the conclusion that it was made personally rather than to the temple, even if the temple existed when the grant was made (Poohari Fakir Sadavarthy of Bondilipuram v. The Commissioner, Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments). The grant must be determined from the entries and recitals considered together, including the title deed.

rule.if: appeal_over_inam_ownership and register_records_hereditary_grant and register_identifies_priests_as_enjoyers and register_records_priest_heirs and official_recommends_grant_to_service_renderers and confirmation_conditions_grant_on_temple_service and title_deed_confirms_individual_priest_and_successors

predicates.appeal_over_inam_ownership: The proceeding is an appeal concerning whether a grant of land belongs to a temple or to its officiating priests.
predicates.register_records_hereditary_grant: The grant register describes the grant as hereditary.
predicates.register_identifies_priests_as_enjoyers: The grant register records that the officiating priests enjoy the granted property.
predicates.register_records_priest_heirs: The grant register identifies the heirs of the original officiating priests.
predicates.official_recommends_grant_to_service_ren: An official reviewing the grant recommends treating it as made to persons who render service to the temple.
predicates.confirmation_conditions_grant_on_temple_: The authority confirming the grant makes its continuation conditional on performance of service to the temple.
predicates.title_deed_confirms_individual_priest_an: The title deed confirms the grant to an individual priest and that priest’s successors.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns ownership of a grant and the register, official recommendation, confirmation, and title deed show a hereditary grant to service-rendering priests subject to temple service, the grant is treated as priest-owned and burdened by that service obligation.
